Name: Just Another Haystack Silo
Author: steevejr
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/UgBuzkm.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TxMW9y6.png[/img]

I can't get enough silos shaped like haystacks. Here's one more to add to your fields.

This is a remake of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1519]original haystack silo[/url]﻿ by Flor3nce2456. It's been converted to CP [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9116]a few[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3653]times now[/url]﻿, but no one's made a seasonal version yet. So, I went ahead and recreated the entire thing for all 4 seasons using the basegame tilesheet. Only difference is my version has water in the trough, since I didn't feel like removing it.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/jPCwpsB.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cQEE1dq.gif[/img]﻿
I've added a slightly desaturated version that should match map recolors.
I personally don't use map recolors, but if you do, feel free to recolor and reupload (or send the images to me and I'll upload them here).


[img]https://i.imgur.com/T4lPmWo.png[/img]

You have the choice of a Content Patcher version or an Alternative Textures version.
You can have both, if you really want.[b] If you don't want one, simply delete the folder titled [CP] or [AT].
[/b]
Then drag and drop into your mods folder.

You can only have (1) CP silo replacement at a time, but you can have both AT versions.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/r6LIIQe.png[/img]﻿

You might be interested in some more haystacks:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30005]⭐ mangozey's Haystack Silo[/url]﻿ (recolors the hay bale to be seasonal!)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19793]⭐ Hildegard333's Seasonal Haybales[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3652]﻿⭐ ﻿SlyAceZeta's Tall Hay Stack Silo[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14757]
⭐ tikamin557's Metal Silo

[/url]and...

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5151]⭐ Hay Bales as Silos
[/url]

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/7yd55k2.png[/img]﻿

The idea for the original haystack silo goes to ﻿Flor3nce2456.
My version remade entirely by me using Stardew's tilesheets.

Feel free to do whatever you want with my haystack, as long as you credit me and Flor3nce2456 for the idea.
